trigger.insight: Expansion set the timing, but the pain underneath was engineering drag: about two engineers kept full-time on upkeep, and a sitter-facing roadmap item pushed three quarters running. That is a cost-of-doing-nothing case in the customer's own numbers. Nothing in the transcript shows we turned it into a business case, so our 'grow globally' opener (M1) matched only the surface trigger.

This one had three open loops (PayPal, Venmo, and a promised saved-card reference that was never sent), and the customer now expects to 'find out' during implementation.
